# TASK-157 — Task breakdown engine

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Automatic task breakdown and agent access (2026-10-02)

## Intent

One deterministic function, not a model: foundations from the stack, one epic per component, requirements by priority, tests beside what they verify, use cases after their requirements, "won't" in the backlog, and a list of gaps. Every item keeps its identifier as the card identifier, so boards that already exist keep their columns, assignees and pull requests; only grouping, order and `dependsOn` are refreshed. Derived cards (a missing test, a stack setup) have their own identifiers and are marked obsolete, never deleted, when their source disappears.

## What it delivers

`shared/task-plan.ts`. Verified by `tests/task-plan.test.ts` (23: ordering, priorities, derived tests, loops dropped, French, 2000-card limit, merge into a flat board without losing progress, `.plan/tasks.md` round trip, ready tasks) and `views/board.test.tsx`.
